articles.company_name: Black Stone Minerals L.P. Common units representing limited partner interests
articles.summary: Black Stone Minerals, L.P. (NYSE: BSM) (“Black Stone,” “BSM,” or “the Partnership”) today declared the distribution attributable to the third quarter of 2026. Additionally, the Partnership announced the date of its third quarter 2026 earnings call. Common Distribution The Board of Directors of Black Stone’s general partner has approved a cash distribution of $0.35 per common unit attributable to the third quarter of 2026. This represents an increase of approximately 9% over the common distribution paid with respect to the prior quarter and approximately 17% from the $0.30 per unit distribution paid with respect to the first quarter of 2026. Distributions will be payable on November 13, 2026, to unitholders of record on November 6, 2026. Taylor DeWalch, Black Stone’s Co-CEO and President, commented, “We are pleased to announce another increase in our distribution to common unitholders, reflecting continued strong performance across our business and a constructive commodity price
articles.title: Black Stone Minerals, L.P. Announces Distribution Increase and Schedules Earnings Call to Discuss Third Quarter 2026 Results
